Exact count games, a legal all-count converse, and an explicit count test establish the square-root-budget detection scale. The certified all-allocation obstruction at \(4.0801\sqrt B\) is retained. Fixed finite count families have multiscale Gaussian/discrete comparisons and computable certificates, while unknown-margin mixtures obstruct a uniform observed-flag reduction. The continuum Gaussian corner now has a terminating full-null primal/dual evaluator. At the balanced \(4.08\) regression its value is between \(0.7984\) and \(0.7988\); the calibrated monotone union rule is strictly suboptimal.
